insight: Consumers can accept an offer only within personal conditions.
requirement: Show delivery fee, ETA, allowed categories and courier safeguards before checkout.
hypothesis: A contextual offer can outperform one-size-fits-all messaging on qualified interest.

insight: Category choice changes what feels acceptable.
hypothesis: Category-aware offers improve qualified intent compared with a single offer.

insight: Home and work are different order contexts.
requirement: Capture delivery context before displaying eligibility.
hypothesis: Context-aware options reduce invalid attempts and post-checkout cancellation.

insight: Courier treatment can be a non-negotiable condition.
requirement: Publish specific, verifiable courier safeguards and prohibit offers breaching the minimum standard.
hypothesis: Transparent safeguards improve qualified intent among customers who condition their use on worker treatment.

insight: Delivery feasibility may depend on geography.
requirement: Check service-zone feasibility and operational capacity before promising an ETA.

insight: Research themes need testable business decisions.
requirement: Log eligibility conditions and outcomes with privacy minimisation.
hypothesis: Structured instrumentation reveals which restrictions cause avoidable dropout.
